observations: Electronic keyboard wrapped in clear plastic film.

The keyboard has 61 keys (56 white, 5 black).

No power adapter is visible in the photos.

risks.proof: A video showing the unit powered on, the screen active, and keys producing sound.

risks.risk: Individual keys may be unresponsive or dead.
risks.proof: A video of every key being pressed and released.

risks.risk: The power adapter may be missing or damaged.
risks.proof: A photo of the power adapter and its connector.

proof_requests: Video of the keyboard powered on and playing a scale across all keys.
Photo of the model number sticker on the back or bottom of the unit.
response.reason: The item is clearly identified as a Yamaha NX-7 keyboard from the photos. It can be priced at its worst-case value (non-functional) until proof of operation is provided.
